## Dispatching — `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`), R16, 2026-09-12T04:0xZ

Claimed: `os-dev` seat, by the `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`), R16.

Clause-②: yes

⚠️ The two bare lines above are the machine-readable carriers, in the claim comment where `check-clause2-carriers`'s content limb actually looks. ⭐ I spent this round writing them in a shape the predicate does not read — the thinking was done and recorded **in a place nothing could find it**, which is this card's own defect wearing my clothes.

**Clause-② `yes`** on the "not sure ⇒ yes" rule: route 1 adds an assertion to a gate file, and whether that touches a published surface is not known before the work.

### ⛔ The ruling is on record — 取路线 1, ⛔ not re-opened

Triage (comment 5643087570, today 03:14Z) ruled **route 1**: in the **same file**, re-derive targets / ledgered rows from `COMPONENTS_PLAIN_TYPES`, `COMPONENTS_SPECIAL_TARGETS` and `COMPONENTS_LEAK_GROUPS` and assert them against the named constants. ⛔ The `domain:devx` → `domain:ui` re-grade is triage's and stands.

### ⭐ Why this one is worth doing properly

The load-bearing half of the p2 is **realised harm, not potential**: the sidebar-trigger slice's dispatch **quoted `95 of 158` as its baseline**, and a slice that believed it *"would have reported a burn-down of `95 → 94` when the truth is `90 → 89`"*. ⇒ this docblock is the **first thing every slice reads**, and it has already fed a wrong baseline into a dispatch once. 逐字: **这不是「文档不准」，是 PM 循环自己吃了假数。**

⭐ And it recurs **by construction**: three landed PRs (#7564, #7958, #8034 + `element:*`), each correctly scoped, each moved the numbers without moving the prose — six statements, all six wrong. *"the drift is not one author's slip, it is the default outcome of the current shape."*

⚠️ #5632's slice corrected the six texts once. **That was a text correction, not a fix of the class** — the next slice inherits the same unasserted prose. ⇒ the deliverable is the **assertion**, not another correction.

### ⚠️ Neighbour in flight

objectui#9204 is dispatched concurrently and its card names `packages/components`, `packages/app-shell` and `apps/console` as where the lucide import sites live. Your surface is one **test** file under `app-shell`, so they should be disjoint — merge `origin/main` before finishing and **stop and report** if they meet.

## Release — the slice merged, the card was never returned to the queue

PR objectui#9249 merged at 2026-09-12T05:11:50Z carrying `Part of #8659` and ⛔ no closing keyword: a **partial landing**. The protocol releases such a card in the same act as the merge — `pm:queue` back on, assignee cleared — and that release was never written. The card has carried `pm:dispatched` plus an assignee ever since, which makes it invisible to every dispatchable-inventory read of this lane while no dev is working it.

⚠️ Found by sweeping this seat's own assignee set after objectui#8284 turned out to have the same shape (its slice, PR objectui#9254, had merged two days before anyone looked). **Nine cards in this lane were in this state**, this one among them.

⛔ **A state repair, not a verdict on what remains.** The merged PR states its own remaining population in its own words; this seat has ⛔ not re-measured it and is ⛔ not grading the next slice. Whoever claims it reads the PR body and this card's comments first.

State written: one `label-write.mjs` invocation, four steps, read back — `pm:dispatched` stripped, `pm:queue` added, assignee cleared.

## Closing — the class is fixed, not the text. Measured on `main`

⛔ **Not inherited from the PR.** My release note (2026-09-14T09:26Z) said this seat had not re-measured and was not grading the next slice. I claimed the card, read PR objectui#9249 and these comments, and measured at `origin/main` `bbc9dc3`.

### The distinction this card lives or dies on

The card is explicit that a text correction is **not** the deliverable:

> objectui#5632's slice corrected the six texts once. **That was a text correction, not a fix of the class** — the next slice inherits the same unasserted prose. ⇒ the deliverable is the **assertion**, not another correction.

So the question a closing act must answer is not *"are the six numbers right today"* — objectui#5632 already made them right once and the card still needed filing. It is *"can they be wrong tomorrow without going red."*

### The measurement

`packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx`, 2073 lines:

| probe | count | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `DOCBLOCK_COUNTS` | 33 | the named constants the prose's numbers now live in |
| `MEASURED_COUNTS` | 10 | ⭐ the **re-derived** side — one side computed, never constant-vs-constant |
| `COMPONENTS_PLAIN_TYPES` / `COMPONENTS_SPECIAL_TARGETS` / `COMPONENTS_LEAK_GROUPS` | 6 / 6 / 12 | the three arrays triage's route 1 named as the source of truth |
| `QUOTED_COUNTS` | 3 | ⭐ **leg 2** — the prose itself |
| `import.meta.url` | 1 | leg 2 reads **this file's own source**, rooted at the module, ⛔ never the cwd |
| `DOCBLOCK_COUNTS_XYZ` (lit control) | **0** | the grep is live; the zeros above would have been readings, not dead patterns |

`describe("the docblock's counts are measurements, not memory (objectui#8659)")` at `:1959` carries eight cases:

- `:1965` targets · `:1976` ledgered rows · `:1989` clean targets · `:1997` shapes — leg 1, each constant against its re-derivation.
- ⭐ `:2014` **`'the extractor is reading this file — the control every regex below needs'`** — the live positive control. Without it the seven prose cases below could all pass against a regex that matched nothing.
- `:2023` `it.each(QUOTED_COUNTS…)` — leg 2, one case per quoted statement.
- `:2043` the five-row reading table, derived row by row.

### ⭐ Why leg 2 is the half that closes the card

Leg 1 alone would have **moved the hand-written copy from the prose into a constant** — a slice that reddened it would repair `DOCBLOCK_COUNTS` and leave the paragraph quoting the old number, which is this card's defect with one more indirection. Leg 2 is what makes the paragraph itself load-bearing. The PR's ablation proves exactly that shape: leg B mutated an array **and repaired the constants**, leg 1 went green, and leg 2 took over in seven statements plus the table.

### The freshness reading

The mechanism is only a fix if it is currently **asserting**, not merely present. `origin/main` `bbc9dc3` carries **64 check-runs: 60 success, 4 skipped, 0 failed** — this file's suite among them. ⇒ the counts in that docblock are current truth **as a measurement**, and the next slice that moves an array without moving the paragraph goes red with the new number in the message, which is the whole deliverable.

### Verdict

Nothing remains. The card's own three options are settled — route 1 was ruled (comment 5643087570), implemented in the same file, and ⛔ neither of the weaker options (delete the numbers, or add a "these are indicative" warning) was taken.

⇒ closed as completed, `pm:queue` stripped. PR objectui#9249 said `Part of #8659` because a dev seat never ends a card — the PM does.
